sentences.en: So Wiwa is implemented in RuSt.
sentences.zh: Wiwa 是用 Rust 实现的。

sentences.en: Dialog APL is implemented in a combination of C and C++, but it's closed source, so you can't see it.
sentences.zh: Dialog APL 是用 C 和 C++ 混合实现的，但它是闭源的，所以你看不到源码。

sentences.en: J is implemented in C, albeit a version of C that I would call Macro C, because there's like 10,000 macros and you basically code in the macros, not an actual C.
sentences.zh: J 是用 C 实现的，尽管我称之为“宏 C”版本，因为里面有大约一万个宏，你基本上是在写宏，而不是真正的 C 代码。

sentences.en: BQN is implemented in C, although the initial version that I used was a JavaScript implementation.
sentences.zh: BQN 是用 C 实现的，不过我最初用的是 JavaScript 实现版本。

sentences.en: TinyApple is implemented in Haskell, and CAP is implemented in Kotlin.
sentences.zh: TinyApple 是用 Haskell 实现的，而 CAP 是用 Kotlin 实现的。

sentences.en: You know, we might have services that are like 99.999% reliable, but we do not have software that is 99.999% bug-free.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可能拥有可靠性达到 99.999% 的服务，但我们没有 99.999% 无 bug 的软件。

sentences.en: Even the best software releases have some amount of bugs in them.
sentences.zh: 即使是最好的软件版本也难免会有一些 bug。

sentences.en: It's called Map in Parrot C++.
sentences.zh: 在 Parrot C++ 中它被称为 Map。

sentences.en: It's also called Map in Parrot Python.
sentences.zh: 在 Parrot Python 中它也叫 Map。

sentences.en: And the CUDA C++ backend uses a make transform iterator, and the CUDA.compute backend uses an iterator.transform iterator.
sentences.zh: CUDA C++ 后端使用了 make transform 迭代器，而 CUDA.compute 后端使用了 iterator.transform 迭代器。

sentences.en: So it's, you know, basically the same thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这基本上是一回事。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 279, recorded on March 10th, 2026.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听 ADSP 播客，第 279 期，录制于 2026 年 3 月 10 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we chat about arraybox.dev, some Parrot algorithms, the future of agentic software development, and more.
sentences.zh: 我是 Connor，今天我和我的联合主持人 Bryce 一起聊聊 arraybox.dev、一些 Parrot 算法、代理式软件开发的未来等等。

sentences.en: All right, what should we talk about next?
sentences.zh: 好的，接下来我们聊点什么？

sentences.en: Should we talk about, we've mentioned Arraybox a couple times.
sentences.zh: 我们要不要聊聊 Arraybox？我们已经提到过几次了。

sentences.en: We should, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们应该聊聊。

sentences.en: Let's talk about Arraybox.
sentences.zh: 来聊聊 Arraybox 吧。

sentences.en: It's still on the short list of things that we have yet to talk about, but you said Arraybox.
sentences.zh: 它还在我们待讨论的简短列表里，但你提到了 Arraybox。

sentences.en: Okay, so Arraybox is something that I started back in January.
sentences.zh: 好的，Arraybox 是我一月份开始做的项目。

sentences.en: It's now been live, arraybox.dev, for, it looks like since February 6th or 7th.
sentences.zh: 它现在已经上线了，arraybox.dev，看起来是从 2 月 6 日或 7 日开始的。

sentences.en: So over a month now.
sentences.zh: 所以已经超过一个月了。

sentences.en: We're recording this on March 10th.
sentences.zh: 我们现在是在 3 月 10 日录音。

sentences.en: And there's been just under 1,000 unique visitors.
sentences.zh: 目前已经有近 1,000 名独立访客了。

sentences.en: I made the mistake of when I initially launched it, I didn't really look at how they were
sentences.zh: 我刚上线时犯了个错误，我没怎么注意他们是如何

sentences.en: tracking the visitors, and I only wanted, like, unique IP addresses, but they were resetting it every 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 追踪访客的，我只想统计独立 IP 地址，但他们每 24 小时就会重置一次。

sentences.en: So pretty quickly, I hit, like, 1,500 visitors, and I was like, that seems a bit high.
sentences.zh: 所以很快我就达到了 1,500 名访客，当时我就想，这看起来有点高。

sentences.en: And when I asked for an explanation, they said, oh, yeah, it's, like, resets every 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 当我询问原因时，他们说，哦，是的，它每 24 小时重置一次。

sentences.en: And I said, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，不，不，不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Like, just, I want, once they visited, I don't want it to count.
sentences.zh: 我只是想，一旦他们访问过，我就不想再重复计数了。

sentences.en: And I want to know, like, over time, how many people actually visited.
sentences.zh: 我想知道随着时间的推移，到底有多少人访问过。

sentences.en: And it said, okay, and I'll store the IP addresses.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好的，我会存储 IP 地址。

sentences.en: And I was like, no, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我当时就说，不，不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Don't store people's IP addresses.
sentences.zh: 不要存储用户的 IP 地址。

sentences.en: I don't, I'm tracking nothing here.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不想追踪。

sentences.en: And they were like, all right, I'll do whatever hashing coded, so you don't know.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，我会做哈希编码，这样你就不知道是谁了。

sentences.en: And there's been just under 14,000 code evaluations.
sentences.zh: 目前已经有近 14,000 次代码评估了。

sentences.en: And it's pretty, it's pretty fantastic.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒。

sentences.en: So the idea of the website is there's a bunch of online repls for different array languages.
sentences.zh: 这个网站的理念是为不同的数组语言提供一系列在线 REPL。

sentences.en: There's try-APL for dialogue-APL.
sentences.zh: 有用于 Dialog-APL 的 try-APL。

sentences.en: There's BQN pad for BQN.
sentences.zh: 有用于 BQN 的 BQN pad。

sentences.en: There's WiiWa pad for WiiWa, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 有用于 WiiWa 的 WiiWa pad，等等。

sentences.en: Some of these are better than others.
sentences.zh: 其中一些比另一些做得更好。

sentences.en: And I basically just wanted a one-stop shop where you could code in all of these languages.
sentences.zh: 我基本上只是想要一个一站式平台，让你可以在里面编写所有这些语言的代码。

sentences.en: And so that's basically how I started.
sentences.zh: 这就是我最初的想法。

sentences.en: I went to, I went to Cursor, 4.6 Opus, or maybe it was 4.5 at the time, and said, I want, like, an online repl.
sentences.zh: 我去找了 Cursor，用了 4.6 Opus 版本，或者当时可能是 4.5，我说，我想要一个在线 REPL。

sentences.en: And at the time, I thought this is how the way would have to be built.
sentences.zh: 当时我以为这就是构建它的方式。

sentences.en: But TinyApple is built in Haskell, and they have a Wasm backend, so that can be client-side.
sentences.zh: 但 TinyApple 是用 Haskell 构建的，他们有 Wasm 后端，所以可以在客户端运行。

sentences.en: Wait, Tiny what?
sentences.zh: 等等，Tiny 什么？

sentences.en: TinyApple, TinyAPL.
sentences.zh: 小苹果，TinyAPL。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: The creator of the language pronounces it TinyApple.
sentences.zh: 该语言的创建者将其发音为 TinyApple。

sentences.en: So the six languages that I support at the moment are DialogAPL, BQN, J, WiiWa, TinyApple, and Cap.
sentences.zh: 目前我支持的六种语言是 DialogAPL、BQN、J、WiiWa、TinyApple 和 Cap。

sentences.en: That's K-A-P.
sentences.zh: 也就是 K-A-P。

sentences.en: And so five of those are Unicode languages, and J is an ASCII-based language.
sentences.zh: 其中五种是 Unicode 语言，而 J 是基于 ASCII 的语言。

sentences.en: And so in order of how I'm looking at them, WiiWa is implemented in Rust, DialogAPL, and most of them, I think actually all of them are open source except for DialogAPL.
sentences.zh: 按照我的研究顺序，WiiWa 是用 Rust 实现的，DialogAPL 以及大多数语言，我想实际上除了 DialogAPL 之外，它们都是开源的。

sentences.en: So WiiWa is implemented in RuSt.
sentences.zh: 所以 WiiWa 是用 Rust 实现的。

sentences.en: DialogAPL is implemented in a combination of C and C++, but it's closed source, so you can't see it.
sentences.zh: DialogAPL 是用 C 和 C++ 混合实现的，但它是闭源的，所以你看不到源码。

sentences.en: J is implemented in C, albeit a version of C that I would call Macro-C, because there's like 10,000 macros, and you basically code in the macros, not an actual C.
sentences.zh: J 是用 C 实现的，尽管我称之为“宏 C”版本，因为里面有大约一万个宏，你基本上是在写宏，而不是真正的 C 代码。

sentences.en: Although, you know, technically a macro is C code.
sentences.zh: 虽然，你知道，从技术上讲宏也是 C 代码。

sentences.en: BQN is implemented in C, although the initial version that I used was a JavaScript implementation.
sentences.zh: BQN 是用 C 实现的，不过我最初用的是 JavaScript 实现版本。

sentences.en: TinyApple is implemented in Haskell, and Cap is implemented in Kotlin.
sentences.zh: TinyApple 是用 Haskell 实现的，而 Cap 是用 Kotlin 实现的。

sentences.en: And so initially, I thought that WiiWa, because it's in Rust and they've got a Wasm compilation, you know, backend.
sentences.zh: 起初我以为 WiiWa 因为是用 Rust 写的，而且有 Wasm 编译后端。

sentences.en: BQN, because I had the JavaScript implementation via BQN.js.
sentences.zh: BQN 因为我有通过 BQN.js 实现的 JavaScript 版本。

sentences.en: And TinyApple, because it is in Haskell and has a Wasm backend as well.
sentences.zh: TinyApple 因为它是用 Haskell 写的，也有 Wasm 后端。

sentences.en: I thought those three, you could just build, you know, the JavaScript Wasm things that can live in the browser.
sentences.zh: 我以为这三个可以直接构建成能在浏览器中运行的 JavaScript Wasm 程序。

sentences.en: And the other three would have require a server.
sentences.zh: 而另外三个则需要服务器。

sentences.en: And so that's what I went about doing that, got it all working.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是这么做的，并且让它们都跑通了。

sentences.en: I actually thought, because Kotlin has something called Multiplatform Kotlin, or Kotlin Multiplatform.
sentences.zh: 我甚至以为，因为 Kotlin 有一种叫 Multiplatform Kotlin 或 Kotlin Multiplatform 的东西。

sentences.en: I think that's what it is, KMP.
sentences.zh: 我想应该是这个，KMP。

sentences.en: And they have the ability to do stuff across, you know, different platforMs.
sentences.zh: 它们有能力跨不同平台运行。

sentences.en: However, I couldn't get this working initially.
sentences.zh: 然而，我最初没能让它跑起来。

sentences.en: And so that's how the website started.
sentences.zh: 这就是网站开始的样子。

sentences.en: I launched it at the beginning of February.
sentences.zh: 我在二月初上线了它。

sentences.en: Three of them were client-side, and three of them were server-side.
sentences.zh: 其中三个是客户端运行的，三个是服务器端运行的。

sentences.en: And server-side was a laptop sitting down beneath my TV that is a...
sentences.zh: 服务器端就是我电视机下面放着的一台笔记本电脑，它是一个……

sentences.en: But, of course, you, being a mature and responsible adult, have moved it to a secure, you know, cloud environment, right?
sentences.zh: 但当然，作为一个成熟负责的成年人，你已经把它迁移到了安全的云环境中，对吧？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有。

sentences.en: It is still...
sentences.zh: 它仍然……

sentences.en: And it's not just any laptop.
sentences.zh: 而且它不仅仅是一台普通的笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: It is my wife's old 2012 MacBook Pro, which barely works.
sentences.zh: 那是我妻子 2012 年的老款 MacBook Pro，几乎快报废了。

sentences.en: I mean, yesterday, I think yesterday, the...
sentences.zh: 我是说，昨天，我想是昨天，……

sentences.en: So I have an ArrayBox server manager that basically runs and serves endpoints.
sentences.zh: 我有一个 ArrayBox 服务器管理器，它负责运行和提供端点服务。

sentences.en: And it was running for, I think, like 200 plus hours, which 24...
sentences.zh: 它已经运行了，我想，大概 200 多个小时，也就是 24……

sentences.en: So it was like over a week straight.
sentences.zh: 所以它连续运行了一周多。

sentences.en: And this is also our media laptop.
sentences.zh: 而且这也是我们的媒体笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: So it's HDMI plugged into our TV.
sentences.zh: 它通过 HDMI 插在我们的电视上。

sentences.en: So if you want Connor's Netflix password.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想要 Connor 的 Netflix 密码的话。

sentences.en: And admittedly, when I set this thing up, at some point I said, you know, put this in, you know, a Docker sandbox and, you know, make sure it can't be hacked.
sentences.zh: 诚然，当我设置这个东西时，我曾想过，把它放进 Docker 沙箱里，确保它不会被黑。

sentences.en: And when I launched it, though, as soon as I put it live, I didn't launch it on the YouTube channel.
sentences.zh: 但当我上线时，一旦我把它公开，我并没有在 YouTube 频道上发布。

sentences.en: So I just told a few people about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是告诉了几个人。

sentences.en: And you were, I don't know, probably the sixth or seventh.
sentences.zh: 而你，我不知道，大概是第六或第七个知道的人。

sentences.en: And everybody that I told immediately started trying to go, like, run shell commands.
sentences.zh: 我告诉的每个人都立刻开始尝试运行 shell 命令。

sentences.en: Because APL, DialogAPL, J, and CAP all have the ability to run, like, you know, shell commands locally.
sentences.zh: 因为 APL、DialogAPL、J 和 CAP 都有能力在本地运行 shell 命令。

sentences.en: And so I started getting all these messages of, like, oh, I can look at the contents of this container.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始收到各种消息，说“哦，我可以查看这个容器的内容”。

sentences.en: And I'm like, okay, that's great.
sentences.zh: 我说，好的，那很棒。

sentences.en: And, but, like, it didn't matter that much.
sentences.zh: 但其实这没那么重要。

sentences.en: But you pointed out to me when you...
sentences.zh: 不过你指出了这一点，当你……

sentences.en: So when I told you about this, you immediately started trying to hack this stuff.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉你这件事时，你立刻开始尝试黑进这些东西。

sentences.en: You might be thinking, how does Bryce know J?
sentences.zh: 你可能在想，Bryce 怎么会懂 J？

sentences.en: Bryce does not know J, but AI knows J.
sentences.zh: Bryce 不懂 J，但 AI 懂 J。

sentences.en: So Bryce is, like, showing me that he's, like, looking at the contents of the container.
sentences.zh: 所以 Bryce 在向我展示他正在查看容器的内容。

sentences.en: But you asked or pointed out at some point, you were like, if these are...
sentences.zh: 但你在某个时候问过或指出过，你说，如果这些是……

sentences.en: You asked what they were implemented in.
sentences.zh: 你问它们是用什么实现的。

sentences.en: And I said, J is implemented in C.
sentences.zh: 我说 J 是用 C 实现的。

sentences.en: And DialogAPL is in C and C++, but it's closed source.
sentences.zh: DialogAPL 是用 C 和 C++ 实现的，但它是闭源的。

sentences.en: And then you said, well, if it's implemented in C, can't you get an inscriptum build running?
sentences.zh: 然后你说，如果它是用 C 实现的，难道不能编译成 Emscripten 版本吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, that's a fantastic point and idea.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，这是一个非常棒的观点和想法。

sentences.en: Why did I not think of that?
sentences.zh: 我怎么就没想到呢？

sentences.en: Sure enough, I went to the J source code.
sentences.zh: 果然，我查看了 J 的源代码。

sentences.en: They already have, like, flags for an inscriptum build.
sentences.zh: 他们已经有了 Emscripten 构建的标志。

sentences.en: So I just had to build it.
sentences.zh: 所以我只需要构建它就行了。

sentences.en: And there was actually another REPL online called the J Playground.
sentences.zh: 实际上还有一个叫 J Playground 的在线 REPL。

sentences.en: And I actually just asked Cursor and Claude, like, what are they doing?
sentences.zh: 我直接问了 Cursor 和 Claude，他们是怎么做的？

sentences.en: And they said, oh, they're actually using an inscriptum build as well.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，他们实际上也用了 Emscripten 构建。

sentences.en: So I went and set up the...
sentences.zh: 所以我去设置了……

sentences.en: And that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是关键所在。

sentences.en: I don't know how to go and, you know, set up the...
sentences.zh: 我不知道怎么去设置……

sentences.en: And I remember, actually, several years ago, I did a 10 or 8 or 10 hour live stream where I was porting the J source code to C++.
sentences.zh: 我记得几年前，我做过一次 8 到 10 小时的直播，当时我正在把 J 的源代码移植到 C++。

sentences.en: And I swear to God, I can go find it.
sentences.zh: 我发誓，我能找到那个视频。

sentences.en: I spent the first five hours of that live stream just trying to get J to build.
sentences.zh: 那次直播的前五个小时我都在尝试让 J 编译通过。

sentences.en: Like, this is what we're talking about in terms of, like, 100x, like, productivity multiplier.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所说的 100 倍生产力提升。

sentences.en: I now ask Cursor and Claude to do it.
sentences.zh: 现在我让 Cursor 和 Claude 来做。

sentences.en: Not only do they go and do it, they get the inscriptum one working in, like, 10 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅完成了，还在 10 分钟内就搞定了 Emscripten 版本。

sentences.en: I have my whole backend written.
sentences.zh: 我的整个后端都写好了。

sentences.en: It's now client-side.
sentences.zh: 现在它在客户端运行了。

sentences.en: It's no longer on the server.
sentences.zh: 不再在服务器上了。

sentences.en: And so now we're down to two languages on the server.
sentences.zh: 所以现在服务器上只剩下两种语言了。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, if I can do it for J, I certainly should be able to build this from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我能为 J 做到这一点，我肯定也能从零开始构建它。

sentences.en: Because at first, I was just trying to pull, like, executables from other places and not build stuff from source.
sentences.zh: 因为起初，我只是试图从其他地方获取可执行文件，而不是从源码构建。

sentences.en: But then I basically, once I had the website up and running and people were trying to hack it, I was like, all right.
sentences.zh: 但后来，当网站运行起来，人们开始尝试黑它时，我就想，好吧。

sentences.en: So I just said, this is Kotlin multi-platform.
sentences.zh: 所以我直接说，这是 Kotlin 多平台项目。

sentences.en: Can you build this and get me, like, a Kotlin native or, like, running in the browser?
sentences.zh: 你能构建它并给我一个 Kotlin Native 版本，或者让它在浏览器中运行吗？

sentences.en: Sure enough, five minutes later, it's working.
sentences.zh: 果然，五分钟后，它就跑通了。

sentences.en: And so now we're down to just Dialog APL, which is the only one running on the server.
sentences.zh: 所以现在只剩下 Dialog APL 了，它是唯一一个还在服务器上运行的。

sentences.en: And even that was a bit insecure.
sentences.zh: 即使是那个也有一点不安全。

sentences.en: But I asked a couple folks about it.
sentences.zh: 但我问了几个人。

sentences.en: Or they had told me about it.
sentences.zh: 或者他们告诉过我。

sentences.en: And so then I said, I asked Cloud and Cursor, like, there is some kind of security thing that TriAPL uses.
sentences.zh: 所以我问了 Claude 和 Cursor，TriAPL 使用了某种安全机制。

sentences.en: And that's called, like, Safe 3 Dialog.
sentences.zh: 那叫 Safe 3 Dialog。

sentences.en: So it went and found that.
sentences.zh: 所以它找到了那个。

sentences.en: It took it a while for it to iron out all the kinks.
sentences.zh: 它花了一些时间来解决所有问题。

sentences.en: But it's just wild.
sentences.zh: 但这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, you're a passerby or you don't know anything really about, like, J or these languages.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只是个路人，或者对 J 或这些语言一无所知。

sentences.en: But you using AI, figure out basically how to hack my machine.
sentences.zh: 但你利用 AI，基本上搞清楚了如何黑进我的机器。

sentences.en: But then you come along with an idea.
sentences.zh: 但随后你又提出了一个想法。

sentences.en: And that idea, like, I take, send it back to the AI.
sentences.zh: 而那个想法，我拿去发给 AI。

sentences.en: And it's just, it is just wild that, like, I have wanted this kind of website, like, forever.
sentences.zh: 我一直想要这样一个网站，真的太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Because I'm constantly, for my YouTube videos, you know, testing out these esoteric array languages like Cap and TinyApple that, like, admittedly not many people have heard of.
sentences.zh: 因为我经常在 YouTube 视频中测试这些深奥的数组语言，比如 Cap 和 TinyApple，说实话没多少人听说过。

sentences.en: But there's some really interesting ideas in those languages.
sentences.zh: 但这些语言中确实有一些非常有趣的想法。

sentences.en: But the online repls are pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 只是在线 REPL 太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And, like, navigating the docs and, like, switching, it's just cumbersome and not the experience that I want.
sentences.zh: 而且，比如，浏览文档和切换页面，这太麻烦了，不是我想要的体验。

sentences.en: And now, like, when I want to bring up docs and stuff, I just hit F1 next to a glyph.
sentences.zh: 现在，比如，当我想调出文档之类的东西时，我只需在字形旁边按 F1。

sentences.en: And the code editor just slides to the left.
sentences.zh: 代码编辑器就会向左滑动。

sentences.en: The docs show up, like, on the same screen.
sentences.zh: 文档就会出现在同一个屏幕上。

sentences.en: It looks beautiful when it works.
sentences.zh: 运行起来的时候看起来很美观。

sentences.en: There are some bugs here and there.
sentences.zh: 不过这里那里还是有一些小毛病。

sentences.en: But it's just wild that this is the world that we live in.
sentences.zh: 但我们竟然生活在这样的世界里，真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And I just, I thought it was so awesome that you just, like, it reminds me of Bill Burr has this, like, Steve Jobs joke where he's like, what did Steve, what is the big deal?
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这太棒了，它让我想起比尔·伯尔（Bill Burr）有个关于史蒂夫·乔布斯（Steve Jobs）的笑话，他说，史蒂夫到底做了什么？大惊小怪什么？

sentences.en: Why are all these nerds such a big fan?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些书呆子都这么崇拜他？

sentences.en: You know, what is he doing?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他到底在干什么？

sentences.en: He has this bit.
sentences.zh: 他有这么一段表演。

sentences.en: I'll cut it in here.
sentences.zh: 我待会儿把它剪进来。

sentences.en: But my impression of it is he's eating an apple going, oh, here's an idea.
sentences.zh: 但我对他的印象就是他吃着苹果说，哦，有个点子。

sentences.en: Big, small, big, small, make it happen.
sentences.zh: 大的、小的、大的、小的，把它做出来。

sentences.en: Actually, nerd Jesus died in the last year, right?
sentences.zh: 说起来，书呆子之神去年去世了，对吧？

sentences.en: Steve Jobs.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: Yeah, he died, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，他去世了，对吧？

sentences.en: I know, I know, a lot of nerds here tonight.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道，今晚这儿有很多书呆子。

sentences.en: I know, you're sad.
sentences.zh: 我知道，你们很难过。

sentences.en: I didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: I didn't get the big deal they made about that guy.
sentences.zh: 我不明白他们为什么要把那个人捧得那么高。

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: He told other people what to invent?
sentences.zh: 他告诉别人去发明什么？

sentences.en: I want my entire music collection in that phone.
sentences.zh: 我想要把我的整个音乐收藏都放进那部手机里。

sentences.en: Get on it!
sentences.zh: 快去搞定！

sentences.en: More nameless, faceless scientists got to go in a back room and figure it out.
sentences.zh: 更多默默无闻的科学家得躲在后台房间里想办法实现它。

sentences.en: Steve Jobs just walking by.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯只是走来走去。

sentences.en: I don't hear any thinking going on in there.
sentences.zh: 我没听见里面有什么思考的声音。

sentences.en: Just strutting around the office.
sentences.zh: 就在办公室里昂首阔步。

sentences.en: Eating some pretentious fruit like a pear.
sentences.zh: 吃着像梨一样装腔作势的水果。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Just throwing out ideas.
sentences.zh: 只是随口抛出一些点子。

sentences.en: There's another one.
sentences.zh: 又来一个。

sentences.en: There's another one I just came up with on the way to work.
sentences.zh: 又来一个我上班路上刚想到的点子。

sentences.en: I was reading a magazine the other day, turning pages, you know?
sentences.zh: 前几天我在看杂志，翻着页，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I like to turn pages on a screen that aren't even there.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在屏幕上翻那些根本不存在的页面。

sentences.en: Yeah, wrap your fucking heads around that, guys.
sentences.zh: 没错，你们这些家伙好好琢磨琢磨吧。

sentences.en: See you in eight years.
sentences.zh: 八年后见。

sentences.en: Where are you going, Michael?
sentences.zh: 你要去哪儿，迈克尔？

sentences.en: Big, little, big, little.
sentences.zh: 大的、小的、大的、小的。

sentences.en: Get on it!
sentences.zh: 快去搞定！

sentences.en: And he's doing the gesture with his hands to, like, zoom in and zoom out of a photo.
sentences.zh: 他用手做着手势，就像在放大和缩小照片一样。

sentences.en: And so he's just this, and, like, Bill Burr's, like, a joke is that he's just this guy that would, like, walk around throwing out ideas and be like,
sentences.zh: 所以他就是这样，比尔·伯尔的笑话就是说他只是个会到处走来走去抛出点子，然后说，

sentences.en: I don't hear you thinking hard enough.
sentences.zh: 我没听见你们在努力思考。

sentences.en: Well, I feel like that's been, like, a large part of my value add to NVIDIA is, like, every now and then I meet with, like, a wide variety of people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这在很大程度上是我对英伟达（NVIDIA）的价值贡献，就是我时不时会和各种各样的人见面。

sentences.en: And sometimes I'm like, hey, why don't you try this or that?
sentences.zh: 有时我会说，嘿，为什么不试试这个或那个？

sentences.en: And then, like, somebody comes back to me, like, three months later, and they're like, I spent the last three months working on that, and it worked out.
sentences.zh: 然后，有人会在三个月后回来找我，说，我花了过去三个月做那个，结果成功了。

sentences.en: Or, as is the case, somebody comes back a week later, and they're like, yeah, I looked into that.
sentences.zh: 或者，就像通常情况那样，有人一周后回来，说，嗯，我研究了一下。

sentences.en: It's a terrible idea.
sentences.zh: 那是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: That's, like, 90% of them.
sentences.zh: 这种情况大概占了 90%。

sentences.en: But there is value.
sentences.zh: 但还是有价值的。

sentences.en: That's the thing is there is, like, extreme value in insights.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，洞察力有着极大的价值。

sentences.en: Like, I was about to say ideas, but, you know, taking from Michael, it's, like, ideas that are, like, you know, I don't know, what's the word?
sentences.zh: 我本来想说点子，但你知道，借用迈克尔的话，这是，你知道，我不知道，怎么说呢？

sentences.en: Like, meaningful, you know, or worth keeping, in the words of Michael, once again, it is, like, small things that I think about, just, like, experience, like,
sentences.zh: 比如，有意义的，或者值得保留的，再次借用迈克尔的话，就是一些我思考的小事，比如体验，比如，

sentences.en: UX things with my podcast player.
sentences.zh: 我播客播放器的用户体验问题。

sentences.en: It's so nice now when, like, these things work.
sentences.zh: 现在这些东西能用的时候真是太好了。

sentences.en: Like, every once in a while, you'll accidentally end up, like, hitting the 100% mark on a podcast that you already listen to, and I have this, like, history now.
sentences.zh: 比如，偶尔你会不小心把正在听的播客进度条拉到 100%，我现在有了这个历史记录功能。

sentences.en: So, like, I don't have downloaded and up next.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不需要下载列表和播放列表。

sentences.en: I just have a queue, and when you listen to something, it gets put in history.
sentences.zh: 我只有一个队列，当你听完某样东西，它就会被放入历史记录。

sentences.en: And the idea is, is you might be able to share, like, your weekly recap on social media at some point.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，你以后可能可以在社交媒体上分享你的每周回顾。

sentences.en: But every once in a while, you listen to something twice.
sentences.zh: 但偶尔你会听两遍某样东西。

sentences.en: You can just go, swipe left, hit a delete button on your history, and maybe you don't even want to share it.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接左滑，点击删除按钮从历史记录中移除，也许你根本不想分享它。

sentences.en: That's why you don't want it in your history for whatever reason.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你出于某种原因不想让它出现在历史记录里。

sentences.en: You're ashamed.
sentences.zh: 你感到羞耻。

sentences.en: I listened to the Reality Receipts podcast because I saw a reel on Instagram on the Love is Blind Season 10 finale episode because Shima and I watched Love is Blind.
sentences.zh: 我听了《Reality Receipts》播客，因为我在 Instagram 上看到了《盲婚试爱》（Love is Blind）第 10 季大结局的短片，因为我和希玛（Shima）看了《盲婚试爱》。

sentences.en: And, you know, am I ashamed that I listened to the Reality Receipts podcast?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我听《Reality Receipts》播客感到羞耻吗？

sentences.en: Clearly not because I'm mentioning it here.
sentences.zh: 显然没有，因为我在这里提到了它。

sentences.en: But others might be.
sentences.zh: 但其他人可能会。

sentences.en: And they might want to remove it from their history before they, you know, share some weekly recap.
sentences.zh: 他们可能想在分享每周回顾之前把它从历史记录中删除。

sentences.en: And stuff like this, you know, if more people had great ideas and were implementing them,
sentences.zh: 像这样的事情，你知道，如果更多人有好的想法并付诸实践，

sentences.en: we would all not be whining about the quality of the software that we use on a day-to-day basis, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们大家就不会整天抱怨我们日常使用的软件质量了，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Have you seen that Jonathan Blow 10-minute clip where he just, like, tracked everything that was, like, broken with the software he was using over, like, a one- or two-day period?
sentences.zh: 你看过乔纳森·布洛（Jonathan Blow）那个 10 分钟的视频吗？他记录了他在一两天内使用软件时遇到的所有问题？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I can imagine.
sentences.zh: 但，是的，我可以想象。

sentences.en: I can imagine.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象。

sentences.en: And his point is that, like, we are, like, desensitized to how awful software is.
sentences.zh: 他的观点是，我们对软件有多糟糕已经变得麻木了。

sentences.en: We're just used to, like, you know, swiping up on the app to close it and then reopening it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是习惯了向上滑动应用来关闭它，然后再重新打开。

sentences.en: Like, we are so desensitized to, like, oh, it's not working.
sentences.zh: 我们对那种“哦，它坏了”的情况已经太麻木了。

sentences.en: I'll just restart it.
sentences.zh: 我重启一下就行了。

sentences.en: Like, and it shouldn't be that way.
sentences.zh: 这不应该是这样的。

sentences.en: It shouldn't be that way, you know?
sentences.zh: 不应该是这样的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like, why is it so hard to get things to work correctly?
sentences.zh: 为什么让事情正常运行就这么难呢？

sentences.en: It's like, you know, the complaints that you have about Cursor when it was freezing, you know?
sentences.zh: 就像你抱怨 Cursor 卡顿的时候一样，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It doesn't do that anymore.
sentences.zh: 它现在不会那样了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because you fix it.
sentences.zh: 因为你修复了它。

sentences.en: You fix it.
sentences.zh: 你修复了它。

sentences.en: I mean, I certainly, you know, it's funny because I do go through that exercise, but, like, almost only when I'm, like, using some open-source library or, like, I'm using, like,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当然会，这很有趣，因为我确实会经历那个过程，但几乎只在我使用某些开源库，或者使用，比如，

sentences.en: one of NVIDIA's products.
sentences.zh: 英伟达的产品时。

sentences.en: Like, that Google Doc that I showed you earlier with, like, you know, 100 or 200 to-dos in it.
sentences.zh: 就像我之前给你看的那个 Google 文档，里面有 100 或 200 个待办事项。

sentences.en: Like, some of those are things that are to-dos for the project I'm working on.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是我正在做的项目的待办事项。

sentences.en: Some of those are to-dos for, like, other projects.
sentences.zh: 有些是其他项目的待办事项。

sentences.en: Like, because I'll, like, collect, like, a list of, you know, what's wrong, what could be better.
sentences.zh: 因为我会收集一份清单，记录哪里出了问题，哪里可以改进。

sentences.en: And when you go through and you, like, actually do that, like, it is kind of amazing just, like, how quickly that list accumulates.
sentences.zh: 当你真正去执行的时候，你会发现这个清单积累得有多快，这真的很神奇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It can be shocking.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让人震惊。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I mean, we take all these things for granted.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我们把所有这些都视为理所当然。

sentences.en: That's the reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实。

sentences.en: The other podcast players that I used to use, like, the cast box had gotten so bad that if you were just not on Wi-Fi, like, the app would almost stop working.
sentences.zh: 我以前用的其他播客播放器，比如 Castbox，变得太糟糕了，如果你不在 Wi-Fi 环境下，应用几乎就无法工作了。

sentences.en: I think I recounted that, you know, like, you'd have to go to the downloads because the queue would just entirely disappear.
sentences.zh: 我想我讲过，你必须去下载列表，因为队列会完全消失。

sentences.en: Like, it was, it was, it wasn't network dependent.
sentences.zh: 它不依赖于网络。

sentences.en: It was, oh, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 它是，哦，请继续。

sentences.en: The Amazon Prime Video app, for, like, the last week for me, I cannot watch any content when not connected to Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊 Prime Video 应用，过去一周对我来说，只要没连 Wi-Fi，我就无法观看任何内容。

sentences.en: I've checked all the settings.
sentences.zh: 我已经检查了所有设置。

sentences.en: I have uninstalled and reinstalled the app.
sentences.zh: 我已经卸载并重新安装了该应用。

sentences.en: I have cleared my cache.
sentences.zh: 我已经清除了缓存。

sentences.en: I have, like, cleared all my data.
sentences.zh: 我已经清除了所有数据。

sentences.en: It's, like, nothing, nothing I can do can fix it.
sentences.zh: 无论我做什么都无法修复它。

sentences.en: Or I remember one time, right after I got my iPad, there was a period of time where, like, my iPad, the screen brightness setting was, like, always messed up.
sentences.zh: 或者我记得有一次，刚买 iPad 后，有一段时间我的 iPad 屏幕亮度设置总是出问题。

sentences.en: And if you set it to full brightness, like, any video that you would watch would just, like, look completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它调到最高亮度，你看的任何视频看起来都会完全不对劲。

sentences.en: And it was like that for, like, you know, a month.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了大约一个月。

sentences.en: And it's, like, how does, how do big companies in the scale, how do, like, things get out in the wild like that, you know?
sentences.zh: 大公司在如此规模下，这些东西是怎么流向市场的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And the reality is that, you know, quality control is just not, you know, we might have services that are, like, 99.999% reliable.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，质量控制确实不是，我们可能拥有可靠性达到 99.999% 的服务。

sentences.en: But we do not have software that is 99.999% bug-free.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有 99.999% 无 bug 的软件。

sentences.en: Even the best software releases have some amount of bugs in them.
sentences.zh: 即使是最好的软件发布也包含一定数量的 bug。

sentences.en: Yeah, this, I mean, this is something that I've really started to think about in terms of, like, how do you, how do you develop in a, you know, vibe-coded or agentic, you know,
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我真正开始思考的问题，关于你如何在一种“直觉编码”（vibe-coded）或代理驱动的，你知道，

sentences.en: lead-driven world?
sentences.zh: 线索驱动的世界里进行开发？

sentences.en: And I was talking to Asher Manzanelli, a fellow NVIDIA, about this the other day.
sentences.zh: 前几天我和英伟达的同事阿舍尔·曼扎内利（Asher Manzanelli）谈过这件事。

sentences.en: And I was, I was, I was thinking about this while I was, like, falling asleep is, like, what is going to be the new, like, you know, there's TDD, test-driven development, DDD,
sentences.zh: 我当时在想，当我要睡着的时候，什么是新的，你知道，有 TDD（测试驱动开发），DDD，

sentences.en: domain-driven development.
sentences.zh: 领域驱动开发。

sentences.en: There's a bunch of these different ones.
sentences.zh: 还有很多不同的开发模式。

sentences.en: And I was thinking of the title of a talk, That's Odd, for ODD, which is, like, outcome-driven development or something like verification-driven development.
sentences.zh: 我当时在想一个演讲标题，“That's Odd”，代表 ODD，即结果驱动开发（Outcome-Driven Development）或者验证驱动开发。

sentences.en: Because, like, right now, one of the issues I run into with the podcast app is that sometimes I'll fix something and that'll break something else.
sentences.zh: 因为现在，我在播客应用中遇到的一个问题是，有时我修复了一个问题，却导致了另一个问题。

sentences.en: But, like, you know, I know that there are some kind of Android, you know, UX, you know, it'll have some, like, workflow and it'll test stuff.
sentences.zh: 但我知道有一些 Android 的用户体验工作流会测试这些东西。

sentences.en: But, you know, I have to look into that because it's very tricky for, like, downloading an episode and then listening to it and it hits the 100% mark.
sentences.zh: 但我得研究一下，因为下载一集然后听它直到进度条达到 100% 的过程非常棘手。

sentences.en: And then it should automatically remove, like, testing.
sentences.zh: 然后它应该自动移除，比如测试。

sentences.en: And so the point is, is, like, even if we're not talking about, like, some hobby project, we're talking about work.
sentences.zh: 所以重点是，即使我们谈论的不是什么业余项目，而是工作。

sentences.en: And we're trying to write some kernel that, you know, is speed of light.
sentences.zh: 我们试图编写某种光速运行的内核。

sentences.en: And, like, are we just going to be, like, setting up, you know, we have unit tests and we've got lints.
sentences.zh: 我们是不是要设置单元测试和代码检查工具？

sentences.en: We're all going to become, to some degree, DevOps engineers and test engineers.
sentences.zh: 我们最终都会在某种程度上成为 DevOps 工程师和测试工程师。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is that the importance of testing and verification will only increase.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，测试和验证的重要性只会增加。

sentences.en: Of course, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，当然。

sentences.en: You know, like, I think if you think about it, in the past, if you had your own project, you would – you didn't necessarily need to set up, like,
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，过去如果你有自己的项目，你不一定需要设置，比如，

sentences.en: code formatting or code linting rules or, like, all these various checks because it was, like, just you working on it.
sentences.zh: 代码格式化或代码检查规则，或者所有这些检查，因为只有你在做。

sentences.en: But, like, my experience has been as soon as I have a project where I have external collaborators, then I have to set up all the code formatting and everything so that, like,
sentences.zh: 但我的经验是，一旦我有了一个有外部合作者的项目，我就必须设置所有的代码格式化等等，这样，

sentences.en: everybody – everything is consistent across the code base.
sentences.zh: 每个人在整个代码库中都是一致的。

sentences.en: And I think it's, like, sort of similar here where it's, like, you have this external collaborator on any project and, like,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这里也类似，你在任何项目上都有外部合作者，

sentences.en: the thing that I spend most of my – the majority of my time thinking about is, like, how can I add more checks or verification or validation?
sentences.zh: 我花大部分时间思考的事情是，我该如何增加更多的检查、验证或确认？

sentences.en: And it's funny, I recall a conversation with Titus Wenders, like, in the early days of AI where his proposition is basically you can't have the AI write the tests, that, like,
